# Text input markup reference

Single-line, multi-line, and password text boxes.

### TextBase

Receiver: `TextBase` and derived types (`where T : TextBase`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AcceptTab(bool value = true)` | `AcceptTab` | Sets whether Tab inserts a tab character instead of moving focus. |
| `CaretPosition(int value)` | `CaretPosition` | Sets the caret position as a character index into the document. |
| `ImeMode(ImeMode value)` | `ImeMode` | Sets the IME mode for this text control. |
| `IsReadOnly(bool value = true)` | `IsReadOnly` | Sets whether the text is read-only. |
| `MaxLength(int value)` | `MaxLength` | Sets the maximum text length in UTF-16 code units. 0 means unlimited. |
| `OnTextChanged(Action<string> handler)` | `event TextChanged` | Subscribes handler to TextChanged. Occurs when the text changes. |
| `OnTextCompositionEnd(Action<TextCompositionEventArgs> handler)` | `event TextCompositionEnd` | Subscribes handler to TextCompositionEnd. Occurs when an IME composition ends. |
| `OnTextCompositionStart(Action<TextCompositionEventArgs> handler)` | `event TextCompositionStart` | Subscribes handler to TextCompositionStart. Occurs when an IME composition starts. |
| `OnTextCompositionUpdate(Action<TextCompositionEventArgs> handler)` | `event TextCompositionUpdate` | Subscribes handler to TextCompositionUpdate. Occurs when the IME composition text changes. |
| `OnTextInput(Action<TextInputEventArgs> handler)` | `event TextInput` | Subscribes handler to TextInput. Occurs when the control receives text input. |
| `Placeholder(string value)` | `Placeholder` | Sets the placeholder text shown while the document is empty. |
| `SelectionForeground(Color? value)` | `SelectionForeground` | Sets the color the selected glyphs are painted in; null keeps their own colors, so a colorized document stays readable through a selection. |

### MultiLineTextBox

Receiver: `MultiLineTextBox`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindText(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, string> convert, Func<string, TSource> convertBack = null)` | `bind Text` | Binds the text to a converted observable value. |
| `BindText(ObservableValue<string> source)` | `bind Text` | Binds the text to an observable value. |
| `OnEditingStateChanged(Action handler)` | `event EditingStateChanged` | Subscribes handler to EditingStateChanged. Occurs when the caret, the selection or the undo state changes. |
| `OnTextCommitted(Action<string> handler)` | `event TextCommitted` | Subscribes handler to TextCommitted. Raised after typed or composed text reached the document, once per commit. |
| `OnWrapChanged(Action<bool> handler)` | `event WrapChanged` | Subscribes handler to WrapChanged. Occurs when Wrap changes. |
| `SizeToDocument(bool value = true)` | `SizeToDocument` | Sets whether the desired size is the document's extent clamped to the offered space, instead of the offered space itself; the default is false. |
| `TabSize(int value)` | `TabSize` | Sets the tab width in space characters. |
| `Text(string value)` | `Text` | Sets the text content. |
| `VerticalScrollBarVisibility(ScrollBarVisibility value)` | `VerticalScrollBarVisibility` | Sets when the vertical scrollbar is shown; the text scrolls either way. |
| `Wrap(bool value = true)` | `Wrap` | Sets whether lines wrap at the viewport width. |

### PasswordBox

Receiver: `PasswordBox`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindPassword(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, string> convert, Func<string, TSource> convertBack = null)` | `bind Password` | Binds the password to a converted observable value. |
| `BindPassword(ObservableValue<string> source)` | `bind Password` | Binds the password to an observable value. |
| `OnPasswordChanged(Action handler)` | `event PasswordChanged` | Subscribes handler to PasswordChanged. Occurs when the password text changes; it carries no value, so read Password directly if needed. |
| `Password(string value)` | `Password` | Sets the password text. |
| `PasswordChar(char value)` | `PasswordChar` | Sets the character used to mask the password. |
